# Config 0.2

C++20 header-only JSON configuration library. Start with README.md or README.zh-CN.md.

Authoritative references:
- docs/API.md and docs/API.zh-CN.md: current public API and contracts
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.zh-CN.md: modules, state, ownership and test guarantees
- docs/MIGRATION.md and docs/MIGRATION.zh-CN.md: removed 0.1 APIs and encoded-file migration
- docs/BUILD.md and docs/BUILD.zh-CN.md: integration, dependencies and verification
- examples/: compiled and executed usage examples

Main type: config::Store. Include config/config.hpp. Keys are nonempty JSON Pointers beginning with '/'. Use get<T>, get_or<T>, set, erase, update, merge, merge_file, snapshot, save, reload and subscribe. Optional Watcher and user_config_directory have separate headers.

No global get/set functions, ConfigStore aliases, mutable missing-key policies or registry caches remain. get_or only falls back on absence. config::Error carries a code and optional file context. Automatic persistence precedes publication. Only the writable layer is saved.

Versioned config/v1 files keep user values separate from encoding metadata. Encodings are not encryption. Old encoded files require legacy_encoding=true for explicit import.

Tests are organized by behavior. No fixtures write to actual AppData. The save-lock mutation guard must reject a generated faulty header copy.
